actions.action: Move the plant within about 1 m of a bright window
Alternatively, set up a grow light
Squeeze the stems at the soil line to check for rot
Check the soil with a finger and water slowly when the top 2-3 cm is dry, then empty the saucer
If the soil is hydrophobic, soak the pot in a sink for 20 minutes
Cut back the leggy stems and push the cuttings into the soil to root
Pinch the tips every few weeks
Feed monthly in spring and summer with half-strength houseplant fertilizer

reason: The answer makes low light the main cause but treats overwatering only as a secondary possibility; its main fixes (more light and rooting the stems in the pot) match what worked, and nothing in it is harmful.
